verses.text: Then there was given me a measuring rod like a staff; and someone said, 'Get up and measure the temple of God and the altar, and those who worship in it.
verses.textZh: 有一根葦子賜給我，當作量度的杖，且有話說：起來！將神的殿和祭壇，並在殿中禮拜的人都量一量。

verses.text: 'Leave out the court which is outside the temple and do not measure it, for it has been given to the nations; and they will tread under foot the holy city for forty-two months.
verses.textZh: 只是殿外的院子要留下不用量，因為這是給了外邦人的；他們要踐踏聖城四十二個月。

verses.text: 'And I will grant [authority] to my two witnesses, and they will prophesy for twelve hundred and sixty days, clothed in sackcloth.'
verses.textZh: 我要使我那兩個見證人，穿著毛衣，傳道一千二百六十天。

verses.text: These are the two olive trees and the two lampstands that stand before the Lord of the earth.
verses.textZh: 他們就是那兩棵橄欖樹，兩個燈臺，立在世界之主面前的。

verses.text: And if anyone wants to harm them, fire flows out of their mouth and devours their enemies; so if anyone wants to harm them, he must be killed in this way.
verses.textZh: 若有人想要害他們，就有火從他們口中出來，燒滅仇敵。凡想要害他們的都必這樣被殺。

verses.text: These have the power to shut up the sky, so that rain will not fall during the days of their prophesying; and they have power over the waters to turn them into blood, and to strike the earth with every plague, as often as they desire.
verses.textZh: 這二人有權柄，在他們傳道的日子叫天閉塞不下雨；又有權柄叫水變為血，並且能隨時隨意用各樣的災殃攻擊世界。

verses.text: When they have finished their testimony, the beast that comes up out of the abyss will make war with them, and overcome them and kill them.
verses.textZh: 他們作完見證的時候，那從無底坑裡上來的獸必與他們交戰，並且得勝，把他們殺了。

verses.text: And their dead bodies [will lie] in the street of the great city which mystically is called Sodom and Egypt, where also their Lord was crucified.
verses.textZh: 他們的屍首就倒在大城裡的街上；這城按著靈意叫所多瑪，又叫埃及，就是他們的主釘十字架之處。

verses.text: Those from the peoples and tribes and tongues and nations [will] look at their dead bodies for three and a half days, and will not permit their dead bodies to be laid in a tomb.
verses.textZh: 從各民、各族、各方、各國中，有人觀看他們的屍首三天半，又不許把屍首放在墳墓裡。

verses.text: And those who dwell on the earth [will] rejoice over them and celebrate; and they will send gifts to one another, because these two prophets tormented those who dwell on the earth.
verses.textZh: 住在地上的人就為他們歡喜快樂，互相餽送禮物，因這兩位先知曾叫住在地上的人受痛苦。

verses.text: But after the three and a half days, the breath of life from God came into them, and they stood on their feet; and great fear fell upon those who were watching them.
verses.textZh: 過了這三天半，有生氣從神那裡進入他們裡面，他們就站起來；看見他們的人甚是害怕。

verses.text: And they heard a loud voice from heaven saying to them, 'Come up here.' Then they went up into heaven in the cloud, and their enemies watched them.
verses.textZh: 兩位先知聽見有大聲音從天上來，對他們說：上到這裡來。他們就駕著雲上了天，他們的仇敵也看見了。

verses.text: And in that hour there was a great earthquake, and a tenth of the city fell; seven thousand people were killed in the earthquake, and the rest were terrified and gave glory to the God of heaven.
verses.textZh: 正在那時候，地大震動，城就倒塌了十分之一，因地震而死的有七千人；其餘的都恐懼，歸榮耀給天上的神。

verses.text: The second woe is past; behold, the third woe is coming quickly.
verses.textZh: 第二樣災禍過去，第三樣災禍快到了。

verses.text: Then the seventh angel sounded; and there were loud voices in heaven, saying, 'The kingdom of the world has become [the kingdom] of our Lord and of His Christ; and He will reign forever and ever.'
verses.textZh: 第七位天使吹號，天上就有大聲音說：世上的國成了我主和主基督的國；他要作王，直到永永遠遠。

verses.text: And the twenty-four elders, who sit on their thrones before God, fell on their faces and worshiped God,
verses.textZh: 在神面前，坐在自己位上的二十四位長老，就面伏於地，敬拜神，

verses.text: saying, 'We give You thanks, O Lord God, the Almighty, who are and who were, because You have taken Your great power and have begun to reign.
verses.textZh: 說：昔在、今在的主神─全能者阿，我們感謝你！因你執掌大權作王了。

verses.text: 'And the nations were enraged, and Your wrath came, and the time [came] for the dead to be judged, and [the time] to reward Your bond-servants the prophets and the saints and those who fear Your name, the small and the great, and to destroy those who destroy the earth.'
verses.textZh: 外邦發怒，你的忿怒也臨到了；審判死人的時候也到了。你的僕人眾先知和眾聖徒，凡敬畏你名的人，連大帶小得賞賜的時候也到了。你敗壞那些敗壞世界之人的時候也就到了。

verses.text: And the temple of God which is in heaven was opened; and the ark of His covenant appeared in His temple, and there were flashes of lightning and sounds and peals of thunder and an earthquake and a great hailstorm.
verses.textZh: 當時，神天上的殿開了，在他殿中現出他的約櫃。隨後有閃電、聲音、雷轟、地震、大雹。
